This crate comes from andymac4182/agentuplink at 626ba9365b5d3e1faf8265f0b6ff50cc9111b749, under the included MIT license. mount-rs carries it locally so the HTTP/3 build uses atomic per-peer connection slots. Local transport changes are in src/peer.rs, src/peer_pool.rs and the arc-swap dependency. The rotation integration suite also covers concurrent cold checkout and explicit close/reopen. The HTTP/3 protocol crates retain their pinned upstream revisions.
